note: CD4: helper T cells — lower-right quadrant (CD4+, CD8-). CD8: cytotoxic T cells — upper-left quadrant (CD4-, CD8+). CD4p_CD8p: double-positive T cells (rare; often thymic emigrants or activated transitional) — upper-right quadrant. CD4n_CD8n: double-negative T cells (includes γδT, MAIT, iNKT) — lower-left quadrant. Both CD4 and CD8 are bimodal — quadrant boundaries set at the valley between the positive and negative peaks of each axis.
tips: CD4/CD8 quadrant split on pre-gated T cells (CD3+ enforced upstream by the 'T cells' FCS gate). CD4: CD4+ CD8-. CD8: CD4- CD8+. CD4p_CD8p: CD4+ CD8+. CD4n_CD8n: CD4- CD8-. In-panel co-marker priors: no lineage-resolving TCR / invariant-T markers in this panel, so DNT remains an unresolved mixture. The DPT bucket is heterogeneous; some studies describe CD127/CD45RA sub-structure within DPT (e.g. CD127+CD45RA+ thymic-emigrant-like vs CD127lo CD45RA- activated transitional), so in-panel CD127/CD45RA axes could cross-validate or further characterize the DPT call if its size warrants.
